mathematics.assertion_tested: Reproduce the stored HG2 D and test finite positive strictly increasing power laws F_q(gbar)=A*gbar^q for a counterexample to the claim that every one-variable rule predicts nonnegative D.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: IEEE double precision, Python float; tolerance 1e-12
mathematics.conventions: D is the min-arm-count weighted mean of BRIGHT-minus-FAINT within-bin median residuals; bins floor(log10(sigma)/0.1). Stored delta identifies reference log acceleration. Only 188 supported stored rows are used.
inputs: HG2 stored group records and measured delta; q in {0.01,0.1,0.25,0.5,1.0}
non_claims: No physical model or observational best fit is proposed.
Does not rerun the source pipelines or validate the source catalogue construction.
Does not change the failures of the particular CL2, BS1, GT1, or DS1 models.
